Two short pieces of corn on the cob, each about 4–5 cm long. Including the cob, that is roughly 120 g in total, of which about 70 g is edible kernels. Sweet corn has about 96 kcal per 100 g of kernels, so the food energy comes to roughly 70 kcal. I have rounded up slightly to 75 kcal to allow for estimation error.
